cost.architecture: gradient boosted conditional log continuation cost

label_semantics: 1 means independent verification within the stated budget; 0 is observed bounded noncompletion, never mathematical falsity. Errors, unavailable and unrun observations are missing, never zeros.
selection: Equal-family validation Brier score for completion, successful conditional log-attempt MSE for cost; ties favor linear. Conservative margin maximizes matched validation completion, ties favor larger margin. No refit on validation.
